note: The W06 approval ledger (APP_PLAN decision D4). One entry per (record, field, locale), anchored to the sha256 of the exact text the reviewer read. Empty is the valid starting state: nothing has been signed off yet, and an empty ledger is what makes that claim honestly. Written by a teacher (or by the tooling that records their verdicts); read by scripts/export/export_corpus.py, scripts/validate/validate_review_ledger.py and scripts/review_queue.py --subtract. Contract: contracts/review_ledger.schema.json. Decision: design/review_ledger.md.
